# Foundations-in-ML
Foundations in Machine Learning : There are many types of Artificial intelligence (AI). In this course, We will focus on Machine Learning. Machine Learning is the subset of methods that learn from data to make predictions. Will cover Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and types of Learning. With a focus on Neural Networks.

## Supervised Learning
This is where you have input data that can be labeled with "the answer". And the machine is used to train a model that can pick out patterns, better differentiate data, or make predictions. This is particularly good for:  
 -  Classification: A classification problem exists when the output variable is a specific category.
 -  Regression: A regression problem exists when the output variable is a real value that fluctuates (i.e. dollars, weight, measurement).

## Unsupervised Learning
This is where the input data doesn't have "the answer".  The machine learning model has to learn organically. Find a structure in the data or relationships that may not be evident. There is the potential situation that in Unsupervised Learning, the process could discover multiple "answers".  Or the process finds no answer at all.
